Subject: Restarting pilot — compact architecture pass or async handoff

Hi Sofia —

Sorry we missed the 45-min pilot slot today — I understand your execs were traveling. Totally fine. I want to make it as easy as possible to get the pilot back on track without pulling too many people in. A couple lightweight options below — pick whichever is easiest for you and I'll coordinate: 

A) Quick architecture pass (20 min): focused walkthrough of the inference flow and deployment options (good when stakeholders want a technical check).
B) Full restart (60 min): demo + integration Qs, good if you want hands-on kickoff.
C) Async handoff: we record a short walkthrough and do a 30-min office-hours drop-in later.

If A works, I can slot a 20-min architect pass next week. I put two concrete windows below in ET and your local time — if neither works please pick a time on this one-click poll: https://tinyurl.com/acme-rdwd-poll

- Tue, Nov 11 — 11:00–11:20 AM ET (16:00–16:20 UTC)
- Thu, Nov 12 — 11:00–11:20 AM ET (16:00–16:20 UTC)

Attachments: pilot-outline.pdf (quick agenda + what we recommend you share with procurement).

If procurement needs anything specific up front (SOW, security contact) let me know and I’ll loop in the right person. I’ve CC’d Marcus to run the session if we go with the 20-min option.

Best,
Hannah

Hi Sofia and Lisa —

Thanks for the quick reply, Sofia — Thu, Nov 12 at 11:00 AM ET is confirmed on our side. I’ll send a calendar invite in a moment.

Lisa — welcome — I attached a very small SOW checklist (pilot-outline.pdf) but if you want a formal template I can put you in touch with our contracts team today. Quick answers for procurement up front:
- Data processing: we support customer-managed keys (KMS) and can region-lock inference nodes for EU/US boundaries.
- Retention: default logs retained 30 days for the pilot; enterprise settings available on Dedicated/Private.
- Audit: we can provide access logs and an exporter for SOC-2 artifacts on request.

Agenda for the 20-min pass (very tight):
- 5 min: context and success criteria
- 10 min: technical architecture + deployment paths (runtime, caching, quantization options)
- 5 min: next steps & procurement asks

Attachment: prelim-agenda.docx (contains the tiny agenda + prep checklist). Marcus will run the pass and Monica will be available for quantization/integration detail.

Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.example/invite/rdw-acme-3241 (invite sent). If anyone needs to shift, please use the poll: https://tinyurl.com/acme-rdwd-poll

Thanks — see you Thu.

Best,
